headline_stat.name: fraction of good VISp units with significant direction tuning (ANOVA p<0.01)

stated_limitation: ranking by gOSI alone would be dominated by near-silent units, whose tuning curves are estimated from a handful of spikes and can show spuriously large (but non-significant) gOSI values

justification.dataset: DANDI:000021 Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels VISp drifting-gratings is the canonical, expert-standard choice for orientation selectivity.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, units correctly mapped to VISp by peak_channel_id and filtered to good quality with explicit per-trial epoch counting.
justification.analysis: gOSI uses the doubled-angle circular vector correctly and per-unit ANOVA supplies a valid null, with only minor gaps (collapsed temporal frequencies, no multiple-comparison correction) that do not change the result.
justification.correctness: Headline numbers reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent with the population figure (29 significant + 85 not = 114) and physically plausible.
justification.figures: Figures show the effect clearly with labeled axes, sample sizes, and representative examples; only a cosmetic polar-tick overlap detracts.
justification.honesty: Claims match the figures and the modest 25% fraction is reported honestly with careful example selection, but no result-specific limitations section is provided.
